content.short: BiLira is a Turkish crypto platform and the issuer of TRYB, a Turkish lira stablecoin.
content.description: BiLira is a Turkish crypto company that runs the BiLira Kripto trading platform and issues TRYB, a stablecoin pegged to the Turkish lira. The exchange offers crypto assets with deep liquidity and a transparent fee structure. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists BiLira.
content.meta: BiLira runs a Turkish crypto exchange and issues the TRYB lira stablecoin, listed in the Plasma ecosystem.
